newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stks end mixed as profit-take breaks rally.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stks end mixed as profit-take breaks rally.

text.p: Profit-taking interrupted a rally in Caracas stocks which closed mixed in heavy trade. But brokers said the trend was still up.
"After so many days' rises, everyone was expecting a small adjustment," Valores Union broker Hector Perez said.

The bolsa's 19-share index ended broadly flat at 7,244.17 points, but 5.7 percent up on the week. High bidding euphoria has spread to equities from Venezuela's third round of oil operating contracts auctions where total bids over five days has topped $2.17 billion.
In addition, on Thursday ratings agency Standard and Poor's upped the country's long term foreign currency debt rating to B-plus.
Trade volume grew to a huge 503 million shares, worth 11 billion bolivars ($22.7 milion) boosted by large turnover in Corimon B stock.
Among traded issues, 18 rose, 18 fell and four closed flat.
Merinvest's composite index meanwhile closed off 0.2 percent at 114.78 points.
